title: Custom RFID Cards Manufacturer — Factory Direct from Shenzhen | Proud Tek
summary: Get custom RFID cards manufactured to your exact specifications. Proud Tek is a Shenzhen-based factory producing MIFARE, DESFire, EM4100, and HID-compatible cards for hotels, access control, membership, and ID programs. MOQ 500 pcs, free samples, 7-day prototyping.

sections.title: Why procurement teams choose Proud Tek for custom RFID cards
bullets: 13 years of RFID card manufacturing — 2,000+ enterprise clients across 50+ countries.
Full chip family support: MIFARE Classic 1K/4K, MIFARE Plus, DESFire EV2/EV3, EM4100/4200, T5577, NTAG213/215/216, Alien Higgs, Monza.
Complete customization: CMYK print, foil stamp, UV coating, signature panel, barcode, QR code, magnetic stripe, NFC + contact dual-interface.
ISO 9001 certified factory with in-house testing lab — every batch tested for read range, data retention, and physical durability.
Dedicated project engineer assigned to every order — encoding support, artwork review, compatibility testing included.

faq.question: What is your minimum order quantity?
faq.answer: 500 pieces for custom-printed cards. We can supply smaller quantities of blank cards from stock.

faq.question: How quickly can I get samples?
faq.answer: Free sample kits ship within 3-5 working days via express courier. We cover the shipping cost for qualified projects.

faq.question: Can you match my existing card specifications?
faq.answer: Yes. Send us your current card or its specifications, and we will produce matching samples for compatibility testing with your existing readers and systems.
